Georgia Forestry Commission began phasing out tower operators in the late 1980s for an air patrol system; many towers scrapped and sold (statewide, not site-specific)
evidence.quote: In the late 1980s, the Georgia Forestry Commission began phasing out the tower operators in favor of an air patrol system. Many were scrapped and sold and of the ones that remain, some are used when air service is unavailable.

notes_for_editor: Only tnlandforms.us names this tower. The page has no key for the codes BLL-64713 and gfc-511, so the story does not name the agency or the register behind them. No build date, status or access found. Not on NHLR's Georgia list or FFLOS's Georgia list, checked in the local crawl. Both WebSearch queries returned no tower-specific page. The GFC sentence is statewide context only. Brief status and access 'unknown' left unchanged.
